"""

E_slab = -1631.811   # eV, total energy of slab

xlo, xhi = 0.0, 20.19465  # Angstroms

print(f"Slab energy: {E_slab} eV for {N_atoms} atoms")
print(f"Surface area: {A} Angstroms^2")

print(f"Energy per atom in slab: {E_per_atom_slab:.6f} eV/atom")

print()

# Surface energy (divided by 2 because slab has two surfaces)
gamma = Delta_E / (2 * A)
